//: OpenCues compatibility manifest for Claude Code. Read by `opencues update claude-code [--check|--to <version>]`. Keep in sync with manual testing — every time someone validates a new claude-code version, add it to `tested` (and bump `current-pin` if you want it to become the default).
//tweakcc-pin: Exact commit of Piebald-AI/tweakcc that setup.sh clones + checks out (371a5c4 = 'Prompts for 2.1.236', v4.3.3-era — § 4e anchor verified present; 2.1.236 extracts as one 27.7MB @bun-cjs module so the 4.3.3 parse gate's .cjs check passes). NEVER clone unpinned: issue #276 (July 2026) — an unpinned clone pulled a tweakcc main whose system-prompt pipeline corrupted BOTH shapes (2.1.110 cli.js SyntaxError; 2.1.170 native repack → Bun 'Expected CommonJS module to have a function wrapper'), reproduced on Linux x64. The CC pin and this pin move TOGETHER: bump only after re-running the UPGRADING.md verification against current-pin (upstream lands a 'Prompts for <version>' commit per CC release — wait for it).
//code-split-ceiling: 2.1.242 is the LAST pre-code-split upstream version; 2.1.236 is Anthropic's `stable` dist-tag (Sep 2026) and our pin. CC 2.1.243+ builds with Bun code splitting: ~1400 chunk modules, a 19KB entry stub, and per-chunk stale bytecode. tweakcc's concat support landed (their #969) but two upstream blockers are OPEN as of 2026-09-04: #978 (parse gate rejects the ESM entry chunk → every apply rolls back) and #979 (repack bloats 392MB→694MB with duplicated chunks, config not applied). Our seams S1/S2/S3 verified present in chunk-3ye1v0g2.js on 2.1.259, so the regex surface survives — do NOT bump past 2.1.242 until both upstream issues close AND a full isolated-fork validation (incl. verifying Bun executes patched TEXT over the module's stale bytecode) passes.

//notes.binary-cutover: 2.1.113 (not 2.1.119 — that was an earlier guess). From 2.1.113 onward, @anthropic-ai/claude-code ships a thin Node wrapper + a bun-compile native binary in @anthropic-ai/claude-code-<platform>. Tweakcc 4.0.13+ extracts cli.js from the binary's .bun ELF section, patches the text, and repacks (handles ELF/MachO/PE). Same tweakcc anchor regexes work on both formats; the cli.js text inside the .bun section runs unchanged at startup (bun honours text over its own precompiled bytecode).
//notes.native-binary-fork: For 2.1.113+ installs, the patched binary lives at <fork>/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/bin/claude.exe (a hardlink to claude-code-linux-x64/claude or similar). @opencues/{core,runtime} go in <fork>/node_modules/@opencues/. The injected bootstrap uses __oc_req() — tries bare-spec first, falls back to walking up from process.execPath looking for node_modules/<spec> — so the same patch source works against both cli.js and native-binary installs.
